regime_read: Convergence favors federal technology spending, semiconductor capacity, and defense/IT services, but several signals include sentiment or affiliation rather than hard capital flows. With no calls yet scored in the track record, conviction remains modest, and extended PLTR is a watch rather than a chase.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要汇聚于联邦科技支出、半导体产能和国防/政府IT服务，但部分信号来自情绪或关联关系，而非明确资金流。由于历史判断尚未进入评分阶段，整体置信度保持克制；已明显延伸的PLTR只宜观察，不宜追高。

theses.thesis: IBM has the cleanest contrarian alignment: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity coincides with maximum measured insider buying pressure, a large patent cluster, and open-source/model-download momentum [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. Its substantial recent relative underperformance leaves room for a re-rating, although earnings in 17 days create event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM呈现最清晰的逆向信号汇聚：联邦合同活动大幅加速，同时出现极强的内部人士买入压力、大量专利以及开源/模型下载动能[gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。近期相对表现明显落后，为估值修复留下空间，但17个交易日内的财报构成事件风险。
second_order: BAH — federal IT and analytics spending could support adjacent government-services demand
Federal IT modernization — IBM's contract acceleration implies broader agency technology procurement
Enterprise AI infrastructure — model-download and developer momentum suggest downstream deployment demand
theses.dissent: The extreme contract-acceleration multiple may reflect a weak comparison base or lumpy awards, while the severe relative underperformance may signal operating weakness not captured here.

falsifier.text: Federal contract activity normalizes without corresponding improvement in enterprise demand or post-earnings relative performance.

theses.thesis: MU combines government grant growth, strong measured insider buying pressure, a substantial patent cluster, and bullish investor sentiment without being extended [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. The Ro Khanna affiliation adds a disclosed policy-network connection but is qualitative and should not carry the thesis [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU同时具备政府补助增长、强劲的内部人士买入压力、大量专利和偏多投资者情绪，且股价尚未延伸[gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。与Ro Khanna的关联提供了公开披露的政策网络联系，但属于定性证据，不应成为核心依据[actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: Semiconductor equipment — sustained memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand
AI server supply chain — stronger memory capacity can relieve an important infrastructure bottleneck
Domestic semiconductor manufacturing — grant acceleration points to continued capacity localization
theses.dissent: Retail sentiment and affiliation are weak-quality inputs, and government grants may not overcome the semiconductor memory cycle if end demand deteriorates.

falsifier.text: Government-supported capacity expands while memory demand, pricing, or insider buying pressure materially weakens.

theses.thesis: AMAT's congressional buying cluster, broad analyst bullishness, and large patent footprint align around semiconductor-capital-equipment exposure [congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster]. Negative recent relative performance offers a non-extended entry, but options positioning is ambiguous because put/call is slightly above one and volume/open interest is not independently directional [unusual_options].
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT的国会买入集群、广泛的分析师看多倾向和大量专利，共同指向半导体资本设备敞口[congress_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster]。近期相对表现为负，提供了未延伸的切入点；但期权信号方向不清，因为认沽/认购比略高于1，成交量与持仓量之比本身也不能确认方向[unusual_options]。
second_order: MU — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand
Domestic chip fabrication — policy-linked capital spending benefits production-tool suppliers
Advanced packaging — AI compute expansion can increase process and packaging equipment intensity
theses.dissent: Congressional disclosures and analyst upgrades may be stale or crowded, while weak relative performance could reflect a genuine semiconductor-capex slowdown.

falsifier.text: Semiconductor capital-expenditure expectations keep declining and AMAT continues underperforming despite the congressional and analyst signals.

theses.thesis: BAH offers a focused federal-services read: government-contract activity is accelerating, the Trump-linked signal is on the buy side, and the special-situation channel adds an independent catalyst [gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]. The name is not extended, but only three channels align and earnings in 19 days limit confidence.
theses.thesis_zh: BAH提供了较集中的联邦服务业信号：政府合同活动加速，特朗普相关信号偏买入，特殊情形渠道又提供了独立催化剂[gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]。股价尚未延伸，但仅有三个渠道形成汇聚，且19个交易日内将公布财报，因此置信度有限。
second_order: PLTR — increased federal analytics spending could support adjacent software demand
Federal cybersecurity services — agency procurement acceleration can lift implementation and security work
Government systems integrators — broader contract momentum may extend beyond the prime beneficiary
theses.dissent: Federal awards are lumpy, the political signal may not translate into procurement, and the prior earnings surprise raises the risk that expectations already discount improvement.

falsifier.text: Federal contract acceleration reverses or upcoming results show that awards are not converting into durable revenue growth.

theses.thesis: PLTR has the pack's broadest convergence: accelerating government contracts, strong measured insider buying pressure, unanimous analyst and Stocktwits bullishness, retail attention, and disclosed political/fund affiliations [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [retail_buzz] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, relative performance is already far beyond the extension threshold, so the evidence supports monitoring the demand trend, not adding after the run.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR拥有证据包中最广泛的信号汇聚：政府合同加速、强劲的内部人士买入压力、分析师与Stocktwits一致偏多、散户关注，以及公开披露的政治与基金关联[gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [retail_buzz] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。但其相对表现已明显超过延伸阈值，因此这些证据只支持继续观察需求趋势，而不支持在上涨后追入。
second_order: BAH — federal analytics adoption can create implementation and integration demand
Federal data infrastructure — contract acceleration implies continued spending on data integration
Government AI software — PLTR demand may signal broader agency adoption beyond one vendor
theses.dissent: The bullish analyst and retail signals are crowded, affiliations are not transaction evidence, and the extreme relative move leaves substantial valuation and reversal risk.

falsifier.text: Government contract momentum slows while insider pressure or customer-demand indicators weaken after the extended price move.
